posts.text:
JEPA4R

Most JEPA world models see in 2D. Robots act in 3D.

JEPA4R plans in point-cloud latent space and decodes what it imagines into 4D point clouds.

OGBench Cube-Single: 78.4% vs 46.8% (best 2D JEPA). Zero-shot on a real arm.

 
https://
arxiv.org/abs/2611.19771
